title: AI Agile Pipeline
description: The agent dependency graph that the orchestrator uses to decide which agent runs next. See docs/product/agile/05-pipeline-config.md.

agent.description: Stable agent name in the form {phase}/{short-name}; matches the prompt at .github/agents/{phase}/{short-name}.md and the name: field in that prompt's frontmatter. The phase prefix is numeric-prefixed (e.g. 01_product_docs) so the directory tree sorts in lifecycle order. The phase prefix must equal the phase field. See docs/product/agile/12-agent-spec.md.

trigger.description: One or more trigger shapes. The orchestrator fires when ANY shape is satisfied.

max_retries.description: How many times the orchestrator automatically retries an agent that crashes (non-zero exit, no sentinel) before applying :failed. Default 0 — no auto-retry. Retries use exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s, …).

session.description: Session management configuration for this agent. Controls whether the claude CLI is invoked with a per-issue session ID or a single shared session ID across all issues.

scope.description: per_issue — unique session per work item; default ID: ais-v1-{safe_agent}-issue-{number}. global — one persistent session for all invocations of this agent; default ID: ais-v1-{safe_agent}. Use global for agents that benefit from accumulated context across issues (e.g. doc reviewers).

id_pattern.description: Optional token pattern for the session ID. Available tokens: {agent}, {safe_agent}, {phase}, {safe_phase}, {number}, {kind}, {owner}, {repo_name}, {safe_repo}. Only bare {identifier} placeholders are allowed — attribute/index access is rejected. When omitted the built-in default for the chosen scope is used. See docs/product/agile/05-pipeline-config.md §Session ID tokens.

type.description: Invocation mode. 'agent' (default) invokes Claude CLI with the matching .github/agents/{phase}/{name}.md prompt. 'script' runs the file at the 'script' path directly via bash with the standard environment variables.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the shell script to execute. Required when type is 'script'; ignored otherwise.

max_retries.description: How many times the orchestrator will re-invoke this step after a :failed outcome before giving up. 0 means no retries (fail immediately).
